triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:devx` (`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `take_ticket` / `ticket_state`) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:fleet · Bug · a resumed slot re-enters with its original arrival stamp, so `TICKET_MAX_AGE_S` (840 s) prunes it 300 s into its second wait and the longest waiter falls to the tail. One dev never got the lock in 12 consecutive budgets (about 108 min) while 7 first-budget arrivals did. Every seat and dev serialises builds and tests through this lock, so long cards ship with NOT MEASURED gates and reviews decide on unmeasured evidence. Read from code by the dev; the mechanism is named. A fleet-wide loss this week → **p1** · size XS. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7083392700).

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Second reading of the same defect, from the #36473 dev report: a slot call that timed out at position 2–3 printed "Your place is KEPT as slot issue-36473" (without "never reached the head of the queue"). The next call with the same `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT` logged no "resumed slot" line and queued at the back ("queued: 7 ahead"; position 8/8, 8/10 and 8/8 on three occasions, 2026-11-22 15:15–18:20Z). Calls whose verdict said "never reached the head" did resume their place. The message therefore promises a kept place that the next call does not honour.
